column3: MT 63:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; אֲשַׁחֲרֶךָּ (“I seek you earnestly”) is rendered “Early will I seek You,” and “weary” “thirsty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have seen you” is rendered “I have looked for You.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב (“fat”) is rendered “marrow.”
Close to the Hebrew; “clings after you” is rendered “follows close behind You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will pour him out by the sword” is rendered “They shall fall by the sword,” and שֻׁעָלִים (“foxes, jackals”) “jackals.”
